reports.title: Ferguson Reports Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2026

desk.headline: Sales up 9.5% to $9.0bn and adjusted EPS $3.43, both above estimates; 2026 sales outlook raised to ~7% growth
results: Sales rose 9.5% to $9.0bn: 7.0% organic growth plus 2.7% from acquisitions; price inflation was low to mid single digits.
US non-residential sales grew 15% and residential 6%, despite weak new housing and soft repair work; Canada sales fell 4.5%.
Gross margin slipped 40 bps to 30.9% against a prior-year quarter lifted by supplier price rises; adjusted operating profit rose 8.9% to $962m.
GAAP EPS fell 4.9% to $3.08 because last year had bigger tax benefits; adjusted EPS rose 7.9% to $3.43.
Spent $1.7bn on acquisitions in the quarter, mainly FloWorks; buybacks paused while leverage (1.7x) comes down; quarterly dividend $0.89.

guidance.summary: Ferguson lifted its calendar 2026 sales outlook to about 7% growth (from mid-single digits) and tightened the adjusted operating margin range to 9.6–9.8%, helped by the FloWorks deal. Interest cost guidance rose to about $235m.
